candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that adds msg.value to balances[msg.sender], so deposits no longer update the balance mapping.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender] = msg.value;`, so deposits overwrite instead of accumulate.
Credit the deposit to address(this) instead of msg.sender, so an arbitrary key's balance is affected rather than the depositor's.
Remove the revert guard so SetMinSum can change MinSum even after initialization.
Assign a constant value instead of the parameter, so MinSum no longer reflects _val.
Set MinSum from the parameter inverted with subtraction so the resulting value differs for most inputs.
Add a statement that always reverts before the assignment, so MinSum can never be changed.
Remove the guard statement `if(intitalized)revert();` so MinSum can still be changed after initialization.
Replace the assignment `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so the stored value ignores the argument.
Delete the statement `Log = LogFile(_log);` so the Log address is never updated and stays at its initial value.
Replace the assignment target of the Log update so it is set to the caller's address instead of the provided parameter.
Replace the Log assignment with an assignment to address(0) so the Log address becomes the zero address instead of the given log address.
Remove the Log.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the LogFile history.
Change the balance update from accumulating (+=) to assigning (=) msg.value, so prior balances are overwritten.
Log msg.sender's updated total balance instead of the deposited amount in the AddMessage call.
